writeup: TIC 300146496 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 2.0114 days. The primary eclipse produces a dimming of 2.23 percent, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 42.4 in automated TESS photometry analysis. Pixel-level difference imaging confirms a peak signal-to-noise of 5.8, though the centroid offset of 1.3 arcsec from the target warrants consideration. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a novel find. The pipeline's machine-learning model assigned a screening score of 0.23, indicating moderate confidence in the detection. All data quality checks passed without flags, supporting the validity of this candidate for further investigation.
